# English conventions

## Voice and form
- Lead sentence: pronoun-less, starts with a verb or the client ("Extended CNAV's SharePoint intranet…"). It states client + need + contribution.
- Bullets: start with a strong **past-tense verb**, no pronoun ("Built…", "Reworked…", "Automated…").
- Ongoing mission (`current: true`): present tense ("Extend…", "Build…").
- No "I", "my", "we". Team work is phrased around the person's own contribution (see SKILL.md "Individual contribution focus").

## Useful verbs
Built, Designed, Reworked, Automated, Streamlined, Standardized, Hardened, Simplified, Proposed, Led, Modernized, Rolled out, Enabled, Consolidated, Accelerated.

## Outcome connectors
"so that…", "giving…", "enabling…", "removing…", "cutting…", "backed by…". Use at most one per bullet.

## Vocabulary
- Plain business English; the reader may not be technical.
- Keep product names as-is (SharePoint, Power Automate, WebPart).
- Labels: **Role:**, **Solutions:**, `## Description`.
- British or American spelling: keep one per file (default American).

## Register
Consulting register: precise and professional, never casual or abbreviated. Applies to wording taken from the summary.

| Avoid | Use |
|---|---|
| spec, specs | specification(s) |
| half-working, semi-functional | partially working, incomplete |
| sorted out, settled (a request) | resolved, arbitrated |
| dug into, poked at | analyzed, reviewed in depth |
| got it working | made it operational |

The table shows the pattern, not an exhaustive list: apply the same correction to any casual or abbreviated word.

## Example (built only from the reference's facts)

Rewritten (416 chars / 8 lines, within budget):

```markdown
## Description

Extended CNAV's SharePoint intranet with custom components built around everyday user needs.
- Built two link WebParts, partly user-customizable, giving each employee direct access to their tools.
- Reworked alert handling on the network-support portal: a WebPart to track and raise alerts, backed by optimized Power Automate flows.
- Automated folder-tree creation and color-coding, removing a repetitive manual task.
```

Inferences in this example (would be listed `to confirm`): "built around everyday user needs", "direct access to their tools", "removing a repetitive manual task".
This example illustrates style only. Never copy its content into another experience.
